caption: The drawing depicts a wooden horse sculpture standing on a rectangular wooden base. The horse is rendered in shades of brown, illustrating the wood grain and texture with varying tones to suggest depth and form. The figure of the horse is stylized and simplified, with elongated body proportions and straight, block-like legs attached to the base. The horse’s head is slightly lowered and bent forward, and both the base and the body show wood-like patterns in darker and lighter browns. The image is set against a light beige background, and everything is contained within a rectangular outline close to the edge of the paper. The artist’s signature appears in the lower left corner.
title: Horse
